title: Composable Window Content Layout
description: Implement composable window layout keys (anchor, justify, height, text-size, image-fit) and SemioImage primitive in semio-window.sty
summary: Extended semio-window with composable layout keys on all window kinds: anchor (9-point), justify, height, text-size (dimension or fit with validation), and image-fit. Added semio_window_tcb_open:n wiring valign/halign/height/fit into kind and generic paths; semio_window_content_state_reset: fixes state leaks and defaults halign to justify. Implemented \SemioImage with contain/cover/fill/none modes, settowidth/settototalheight measurement, fp_eval cover crop via trim+clip, and plain-TeX graphics helpers (no ExplSyntaxOff inside box bodies). Migrated Arbeitsprobe cover to Window[height=10.8cm, row, anchor=center] + \SemioImage. Added layout demos to report.content.tex. Fixed register body macro apply via :eee variant and grouped TOC render ExplSyntaxOff. Verified: bun ./📜️script.ts build forschungsbericht flyer succeeds; screenshots in ticket folder. Report template still fails on tableofcontents/semiotoc aux (pre-existing path/state issue unrelated to image layout).
